Glance Speedlab
================

21 measured experiments on low-latency local camera VLM inference.
Headline: 8-bit MLX direct scoring reduced fresh-frame p50 from 358.5 ms to 259.6 ms (1.381x; 27.6% lower) on Apple M5, 32 GB unified memory.
Guardrail: 84/84 fixed-suite decisions matched; maximum probability drift 0.039.
Source and full evidence: https://github.com/yoheinakajima/glance-speedlab
